name: superpowers-progress
description: Progress bar above the prompt for superpowers workflows (brainstorm, plan, build, review, finish), plus a crew panel (/crew) with a unique pixel crab for every subagent.

autoOpen.title: Open the crew panel
autoOpen.description: superpowers: when a plan starts executing or a superpowers subagent starts; any: also when any other subagent starts; off: only with /crew

workerSteps.title: Worker step reports
workerSteps.description: on: superpowers subagents get one line asking them to report their steps, which draws a per-crab progress bar; off: their bars show context fill instead
